evidence.reason: render_units recursively lists every crq-* file under ops/systemd, but writes each rendered template to output / source.name. If two source paths share a basename, such as crq-repair.service and extra/crq-repair.service, line 707 maps both to the same output path, atomic_bytes silently overwrites the first render, and paths returns duplicate entries. There is no duplicate-basename check before writing. Rejecting duplicate basenames before creating output files is a small correctness fix for the existing rendering behavior, not a new requirement.
